name: cms
description: Full-stack CMS with backend API, admin panel, and public site

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin-panel && npm install --prefix public-site
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run db:up" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:public"
scripts.dev:fast: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:public"
scripts.build:all: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix admin-panel && npm run build --prefix public-site
scripts.typecheck: concurrently "npm run typecheck --prefix backend" "npm run build --prefix admin-panel -- --mode types-only" "npm run build --prefix public-site -- --mode types-only"
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml down -v && docker-compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d
